entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac. I'd like to start a return for a VeloBand I bought recently.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
Oh, no, it works perfectly fine. To be honest, I just changed my mind. It was a bit of an impulse buy and I just don't use it as much as I thought I would.
I see. Thank you for clarifying. Can I get the order number to pull up the details?
Sure, it's VF-8675309.
Got it. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse GPS Tracker. It looks like it was delivered 18 days ago, on December 26th. Is that correct?
Yes, that sounds right. So, can you process the return for me?

I've reviewed the policy, and unfortunately, I won't be able to process a return for a refund. The VeloBand Pulse has a specific 10-day return window due to the device activation linking the hardware to a user account and for hygiene reasons.

Oh. I thought it was 90 days. Okay, I understand I'm outside the 10-day window, but 18 days isn't that much longer. Is there any flexibility? Maybe a partial store credit or even a discount code for a future purchase?

I appreciate you asking, and I understand where you're coming from. However, for this particular product, the 10-day policy is a hard stop and we're not able to offer credits for preference-based returns outside of that window. But I do have an alternative solution for you.
Okay, I'm listening.

We have an official VeloFit Resale Marketplace. It's a platform where our customers can sell their gently-used gear to other VeloFit enthusiasts. Since your device is in perfect working condition, it's a great option to recoup most of your cost. The market for a nearly-new Pulse is very strong right now.
A resale marketplace... that's actually a pretty good idea. I wouldn't have to deal with random sites, and the buyer would know they're getting a real VeloFit product. Is it easy to use?

It's very straightforward. You create a listing, set your price, and we facilitate the connection. It's a much better option than letting the device sit in a drawer. Would you like me to email you the direct link to the marketplace to get you started?
Yes, please do. That sounds like a fair solution. Thank you, Isaac.
You're very welcome. I've just sent that email to the address on file. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. I appreciate your help.
Glad I could help. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
